# Third chapter

This chapter lives in a subdirectory, so its page sits one level below the
marker chapter's and every link between them has to account for that.

A cross-reference whose target entry no mark in this chapter contributes:
[Delta]{.index see="Alpha"}.

A cross-reference to a target no chapter contributes at all, which must
render as unlinked text: [Epsilon]{.index see="No Such Entry"}.

The shared term picks up its third locator here: [Shared Term]{.index}.

One more term for the letter group `Beta` opens in the chapter before this
one: a group gathers what every chapter contributed, not what one chapter
did. [Beacon]{.index}.
